card.real_world_note: A respected religious or political figure whose presence steadies the troops around him. Morale, belief and cohesion matter in combat as much as weapons do. The Ayatollah (Iran, Lebanese Shia, Zaidi Shia Movement): Steadfast (infantry near him recover from suppression twice as fast, take 15% less artillery and air damage), Path of Hussein (a fallen soldier near him raises a green banner for 20 s; comrades nearby hit 8% harder, up to 3), Sermon (120 s: a green halo, +20% fire rate, +15% speed and no suppression for 25 s) and Call to Arms (300 s: 6 volunteer riflemen at him and at each barracks). The Dear Leader (North Korea): On-the-spot guidance (a production building beside him builds 25% faster, artillery near him reloads 15% faster), Unbreakable Spirit (wounded units near him keep full damage and speed; damaged vehicles mend slowly), Supreme Commander's Order (120 s: every artillery and rocket unit near him fires one free volley at a chosen spot, then fires faster and farther for 25 s) and Mass Mobilization (300 s: infantry train 50% faster and 25% cheaper for 20 s, and 8 Worker-Peasant Guards form at each barracks). Press E for the ability, Shift+E for the ultimate. If he falls: mourning, +15% damage for 40 s, and a new one can be chosen after 3 minutes.
